# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby is a sixteen-year-old girl with a beautiful complexion and curly brown hair that she styles elegantly. She has a reputation for being handsome.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)_

## Personality

Ruby is inclined to be hysterical and often cries when upset. She is very interested in romance and boys, enjoying the prospect of having her life tormented by their teasing. She also has a habit of gossiping with her schoolmates.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P17](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0017), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039)_

## Traits

- Hysterical  <sub>[v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039)</sub>
- Interested in boys and romance  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P17](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0017)</sub>

## History

Ruby Gillis attends the Avonlea school where she sits in the back row. She is sixteen years old and is known to her classmates for her attractive appearance. She frequently observes and gossips about the schoolmaster's interest in Prissy Andrews. During a prank by Gilbert Blythe, who pins her long yellow braid to her seat, she becomes hysterical when she tries to get up.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039)_
